projection: overhead ground material, warped through the existing terrain mesh

materials.description: Seamless top-down finely detailed olive meadow: short grass, moss, straw, broken exposed earth and sparse pebble grit. Painterly realistic strategy-game material with shallow surface shading. No buildings, trees or upright scenery.

Seamless top-down finely detailed gray-olive alpine mineral ground: angular stone chips, gravel, weathered rock, olive moss and lichen in crevices. Painterly realistic strategy-game material with shallow surface shading. No large boulders or upright scenery.

shipping.normalization: ImageMagick resize to square shipping density and strip redundant metadata; retained generated source originals above.
shipping.biomeTreatment: Small fixed-size tinted material bank for taiga, tundra and desert. Meadow, scree, sand and snow treatments retain the ground relief color underneath, with 7-world-pixel feathered boundaries and seeded irregular multi-cell moss patches on scree.
shipping.cache: At most 12 prepared 256-square RGBA surfaces (3 MiB), 12 softly feathered 128-square moss stamps (768 KiB), and shared scratch surfaces capped by the existing padded chunk size (about 4 MiB). Homogeneous chunks paint their pattern directly; mixed materials use a quarter-resolution interpolated alpha field without native blur. All work happens only while composing terrain chunks.
